# Win Equipments

> Win Equipments (est. 2008) manufactures compressed air treatment equipment, process chillers, cooling towers and heat exchangers at Arasur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, with 1,200+ installations. Tagline: Save Water and Power.

Address: SF No. 4/195 B, Kallangadu, Nadu Arasur, Arasur Post, Coimbatore 641 407, Tamil Nadu, India
Phone: +91 95972 28969, +91 95972 28975
Email: info@winequipments.com
Supplied across India. City pages: Coimbatore, Tiruppur, Erode, Hosur, Chennai, Bengaluru, Pune, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Kolkata

## Product families
- [Compressed Air Treatment](https://winequipments.com/products/compressed-air-treatment.html): Refrigerated and desiccant air dryers, compressed air filters, drain valves, air receivers and aftercoolers manufactured by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
- [Process Cooling](https://winequipments.com/products/process-cooling.html): Process chillers from 0.5 to 20 TR, engineered chillers, heat exchangers and condensing units, built by Win Equipments in Coimbatore.
- [Cooling Towers](https://winequipments.com/products/cooling-towers.html): Round and square FRP cooling towers 10–300 TR and coil cooling towers 40–280 TR, plus cooling tower spares. Manufactured by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.

## Products
- [Refrigerated Compressed Air Dryers](https://winequipments.com/products/refrigerated-air-dryers.html): Refrigerated compressed air dryer manufacturer in Coimbatore: WRD dryers, 10–2000 CFM, +3°C pressure dew point, 3–16 bar g inlet.
- [Heatless Desiccant Air Dryers](https://winequipments.com/products/desiccant-air-dryers.html): WHD heatless desiccant compressor air dryers, 300–2000 CFM, −20 °C to −40 °C pressure dew point. Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
- [Compressed Air Filters](https://winequipments.com/products/compressed-air-filters.html): WMF coalescing compressed air filters, 40–1700 CFM, GP, ZP, ZO and ZC grades to ISO 8573-1, up to 30 bar g. Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
- [Automatic Condensate Drain Valves](https://winequipments.com/products/automatic-drain-valves.html): Automatic drain valves for air compressors, receivers and dryers: WDV timer, micro-controller and no-air-loss types, up to 1000 CFM. Coimbatore.
- [Compressed Air Receiver Tanks](https://winequipments.com/products/air-receiver-tanks.html): Air receiver tank manufacturer in Coimbatore: WRV receivers, 250–10,000 litres, 7 to 12.5 bar g, hydrostatically tested, ASME VIII on request.
- [Compressed Air Aftercoolers with Moisture Separator](https://winequipments.com/products/industrial-aftercoolers.html): Air-cooled compressed air aftercoolers with moisture separator, built by Win Equipments, Coimbatore. Share compressor capacity and discharge temperature.
- [Moisture Separators for Compressed Air](https://winequipments.com/products/moisture-separators.html): Compressed air moisture separators made in Coimbatore, fitted after the aftercooler to remove condensed water. Send flow, pressure and pipe size.
- [Industrial water chillers and water chiller machines](https://winequipments.com/products/industrial-process-chillers.html): Water chiller machines and industrial chillers, 0.5–20 TR, air or water cooled, with stainless steel tank and pump. Made by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
- [Medical Scan Chillers for MRI and CT](https://winequipments.com/products/medical-scan-chillers.html): Process chillers for MRI and CT imaging equipment, engineered to order by Win Equipments, Coimbatore. Share your scanner's cooling requirement for sizing.

- [Spares for Cooling Towers, Chillers and Air Dryers](https://winequipments.com/products/spare-parts-consumables.html): Spares for cooling towers (fills, drift eliminators, sprinklers, motors, fans) and refrigeration (compressors, condensers, valves, filters).
- [Cooling tower fills: PVC fills, drift eliminators and fans](https://winequipments.com/products/cooling-tower-fills.html): PVC cooling tower fills (600 × 300 × 150 mm), drift eliminators, spray nozzles, PP rings and fan blades from Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
- [Fanless Natural Draft Cooling Towers](https://winequipments.com/products/fanless-cooling-towers.html): Fanless natural draft cooling towers for hot water at 75–90 °C from gensets, furnaces and compressors. No fan motor. Engineered to order by Win Equipments.

## Guides
- [What is a refrigerated air dryer and how does it work?](https://winequipments.com/blog/what-is-refrigerated-air-dryer.html): How a refrigerated air dryer removes water from compressed air: pre-cooling, chilling to a +3 °C dew point, separating condensate and re-heating.
- [Refrigerated vs desiccant air dryers: which do you need?](https://winequipments.com/blog/refrigerated-vs-desiccant.html): The difference between refrigerated (+3 °C) and heatless desiccant (−20 °C / −40 °C) air dryers, and how to choose for your process.
- [How to size a refrigerated air dryer for your compressor](https://winequipments.com/blog/how-to-choose-dryer.html): Why a 100 CFM compressor rarely needs just a 100 CFM dryer: how inlet temperature, ambient, pressure and dew point change dryer capacity.
- [ISO 8573-1 compressed air purity classes explained](https://winequipments.com/blog/iso-8573-1-compressed-air-purity-classes.html): The ISO 8573-1:2010 purity classes for particles, water and oil, and which dryers and filters reach each class.
- [Why fit a refrigerated air dryer? Five practical benefits](https://winequipments.com/blog/key-benefits-refrigerated-air-dryers.html): What a refrigerated air dryer does for a compressed air system: less corrosion, protected valves and tools, steadier product quality and lower risk.
- [Air dryer maintenance in hot, dusty plants](https://winequipments.com/blog/maintenance-tips-hot-climates.html): A practical maintenance routine for refrigerated air dryers in hot, dusty plants: drains, condenser cleaning, filters, dew point and bypass valves.
- [Troubleshooting a refrigerated air dryer](https://winequipments.com/blog/troubleshooting-common-problems.html): Water downstream of the dryer, a high dew point, a drain that won't discharge, freezing or tripping: likely causes and what to check.
- [Compressed air drying in textile, food and plastics plants](https://winequipments.com/blog/applications-textile-food.html): Why textile mills, food plants and plastics shops need dry compressed air, and which dryer, filters and drains suit each.
- [Installing a compressed air dryer: a checklist](https://winequipments.com/blog/installing-servicing-tamil-nadu.html): Where to place a refrigerated air dryer, how to pipe it with filters, drains and a bypass, and what to check before commissioning.
- [What decides the cost of an industrial air dryer?](https://winequipments.com/blog/pricing-in-coimbatore.html): The factors that set the price of a refrigerated or desiccant air dryer, and the questions to ask so quotations compare like for like.
- [Where wet compressed air costs you money](https://winequipments.com/blog/save-energy-reduce-costs.html): How water in compressed air adds cost through corrosion, leaks, pressure drop, component wear and rejects, and how to get the treatment right.
- [How to size an industrial process chiller (TR calculation)](https://winequipments.com/blog/how-to-size-a-process-chiller.html): Work out process chiller capacity in TR from water flow and temperature rise, then correct it for outlet and ambient temperature, with a worked example.
- [Chiller working principle: how a process chiller works](https://winequipments.com/blog/how-a-process-chiller-works.html): How a process chiller works, with a labelled 3D diagram and video: the water and refrigeration circuits, compressor, condenser, tank, pump and controls.
- [Cooling tower basics: range, approach and wet bulb](https://winequipments.com/blog/cooling-tower-range-approach-wet-bulb.html): What range, approach and wet bulb mean for a cooling tower, how to calculate heat load in TR, choose the fill and estimate evaporation loss.
- [Round vs square FRP cooling towers](https://winequipments.com/blog/round-vs-square-cooling-towers.html): How round (bottle) and square FRP cooling towers differ in water distribution, footprint and layout, and how to choose between them.
- [Coil cooling towers for diesel gensets](https://winequipments.com/blog/coil-cooling-towers-for-diesel-gensets.html): How a coil cooling tower (dry cooler) keeps diesel genset jacket water sealed, how it differs from an FRP tower, and which WCC model suits your genset.
- [Air-cooled vs water-cooled process chillers](https://winequipments.com/blog/air-cooled-vs-water-cooled-chiller.html): How air-cooled and water-cooled process chillers reject heat, how site ambient, an existing cooling tower, space and water decide which to buy.
- [FRP vs coil cooling towers: open or sealed loop?](https://winequipments.com/blog/frp-vs-coil-cooling-tower.html): How FRP evaporative towers and finned-coil cooling towers differ in cold water temperature, water loss and duty, and when to choose each one.
- [Aftercooler vs air dryer: do you need both?](https://winequipments.com/blog/aftercooler-vs-air-dryer.html): What an aftercooler does, what a refrigerated air dryer does, and why most compressed air systems use both in sequence before the air reaches machines.
- [Cross flow vs counter flow cooling towers](https://winequipments.com/blog/cross-flow-vs-counter-flow-cooling-tower.html): How cross flow and counter flow cooling towers differ in air path, fill, footprint and maintenance access, and what to ask when choosing a tower.
- [Types of cooling tower and which one fits your plant](https://winequipments.com/blog/types-of-cooling-tower.html): The main cooling tower types, and the three that Win Equipments builds: round and square FRP towers and coil (dry cooler) towers, with how to choose.
- [Automatic drain valves for air compressors: types and selection](https://winequipments.com/blog/automatic-drain-valve-guide.html): Automatic drain valve for an air compressor: timer, micro-controller, float and no-air-loss types, where to fit one, and how to choose.
- [Compressed air dryers: types, dew point and how to choose](https://winequipments.com/blog/compressed-air-dryer-guide.html): A plain guide to compressed air dryers for compressors: refrigerated and desiccant types, pressure dew point, ISO 8573-1 classes and sizing corrections.
- [Moisture separators for air compressors: what they do and where they go](https://winequipments.com/blog/moisture-separator-guide.html): Moisture separator for an air compressor: what it removes, where it sits after the aftercooler, and what to send us to have one engineered.
- [Shell and tube heat exchangers: types, selection and design inputs](https://winequipments.com/blog/shell-and-tube-heat-exchanger-guide.html): The main heat exchanger types, how a shell and tube heat exchanger works, what design information is needed, and what Win Equipments builds to order.
- [Chiller, cooling tower and air dryer prices in India (2026)](https://winequipments.com/blog/industrial-equipment-prices-india.html): Indicative 2026 prices for process chillers, FRP cooling towers, dry coolers, air dryers and receivers from Win Equipments, and what moves the price.
- [How a heatless desiccant air dryer works](https://winequipments.com/blog/how-a-desiccant-air-dryer-works.html): How a heatless desiccant air dryer works, with a labelled 3D diagram and video: twin towers, adsorption, purge, repressurise and the timer swap.
- [Chiller prices in India (2026): water and process chillers](https://winequipments.com/blog/chiller-price-guide.html): Indicative 2026 prices for water and process chillers from a portable mini chiller to 10 TR, what changes the price, and how to get an exact quote.
- [How to choose a chiller: duty, cooling type and site checks](https://winequipments.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-chiller.html): How to choose a water or process chiller: heat load, outlet and ambient correction, air or water cooling, the water side and what to send for a quote.
- [Which chiller for your industry: plastics, food, dairy, oil and more](https://winequipments.com/blog/which-chiller-for-your-industry.html): Which Win Equipments chiller suits injection moulding, dairy, soda, oil cooling and other process industries, from our catalogue applications.
- [Spares price list: cooling tower, dryer and filter spares](https://winequipments.com/blog/spares-price-list.html): Listed prices for cooling tower fans, drift eliminators, dryer valves and fans, pressure switches, filter driers, refrigerant and filter elements.
- [Glossary](https://winequipments.com/blog/glossary.html): definitions of compressed air and cooling terms

## Sizing tools
- [Air dryer sizing calculator](https://winequipments.com/engineering-tools/air-dryer-sizing.html): Size a refrigerated air dryer from compressor CFM, inlet and ambient temperature, pressure and dew point, using WRD catalogue correction factors.
- [Chiller tonnage calculator](https://winequipments.com/engineering-tools/chiller-tonnage-calculator.html): Work out the chiller capacity in TR from water flow and temperature rise, corrected for outlet and ambient temperature, and find the matching WCP model.
- [Cooling tower calculator](https://winequipments.com/engineering-tools/cooling-tower-calculator.html): Calculate cooling tower heat load in TR, check the approach to wet bulb, choose the fill type and estimate evaporation loss, then find a WCT tower.
